identify.what_i_see: A close-up of a white manufacturer label from an Evenflo car seat. The label lists the company, model number, manufacturing date, country of origin, and a statement that the restraint conforms to Federal Motor Vehicle Safety Standards.
identify.listing_text: Evenflo convertible car seat. Rear or forward facing, clean cover. Sticker from the bottom in the photo.

verdict.summary: This is an Evenflo convertible car seat manufactured in March 2015 that expired in March 2025. The verdict is "Think twice" because the seat is past its 10‑year lifespan — plastic degrades and safety standards change, so manufacturers advise against using it beyond its expiration date.
verdict.seller_message: Hi! I’m interested in this car seat. Could you let me know: 1) Has it ever been in a crash, even a minor one? 2) Can you share a photo of the sticker showing the manufacture and expiration dates? 3) Can you also send a picture of the label with the model number and month/year it was made? 4) Are all the original parts and the instruction manual included? Thanks!
verdict.safer_alternative: Look for a car seat manufactured within the last few years that is well within its expiration date and has no crash history.

l23.label: Ask before you buy
l23.headline: Car seat: labels, manual and crash history
l23.cite: NHTSA Used Car Seat Safety Checklist

identify.what_i_see: A convertible car seat installed in a vehicle, with the brand Safety 1st visible on the headrest. The listing text describes it as a convertible car seat in great condition with a manual included.
identify.listing_text: Convertible car seat (installed photo). Car seat in great shape, no stains. Comes with manual.
identify.colors_and_prints: dark brown/black with light gray fabric inserts

verdict.summary: This is a Safety 1st car seat with a verdict to ask before you buy. The most important reason is that NHTSA recommends only purchasing a used car seat if it still has its manufacture-date and model labels, all original parts, its manual, no open recalls, and has never been in a moderate or severe crash.
verdict.seller_message: Hi! I’m interested in this car seat. Could you let me know: Has it ever been in a car crash, even a minor one? Can you share a photo of the sticker with the manufacture and expiration dates? Can you also send a picture of the label with the model number and the month/year it was made? Are all the original parts and the instructions included? Thanks!
verdict.safer_alternative: Consider a car seat that comes with all original labels, manual, parts, and a verified no-crash history, or buy new to ensure full safety compliance.

l24.label: Don't buy (or get the fix)
l24.headline: Recalled: URMYWO Baby Loungers
l24.cite: CPSA §19(a)(2)(B); CPSC 'Stop Online Sale of Recalled Products'

identify.what_i_see: A grey baby lounger/nest with a leaf/feather pattern, lying flat on a tiled floor. It has raised padded sides and a flat base. A small white tag is visible on the underside edge, but no text is legible.
identify.listing_text: Baby lounger, grey feather. URMYWO newborn lounger, soft and portable.
identify.colors_and_prints: grey with dark grey leaf/feather print

quick_judgments.why: The item is a URMYWO newborn lounger in the exact 'grey feather' style described in the recall notice.

judgments.why: The item is a URMYWO newborn lounger in grey feather style, matching the recalled brand, product type, and color/print described in the recall.

verdict.summary: This is a URMYWO newborn lounger. The verdict is don't buy (or get the fix) because the product has been recalled by the CPSC for suffocation and fall hazards, and selling recalled items is unlawful.
verdict.seller_message: Hi, I wanted to let you know this URMYWO lounger has been recalled by the CPSC (recall #25456) due to suffocation and fall risks. Selling recalled products isn't permitted, so I'll have to pass. If you still have it, you can contact Pomona for a full refund following the recall instructions.
verdict.safer_alternative: Consider a crib or bassinet that meets current CPSC safety standards for infant sleep.
